title: Direct Minecart Crafting Recipes
description: Allows you to craft hopper, chest, tnt and furnace minecarts directly from ingots and their respective blocks
body:
This datapack allows you to craft hopper, chest, TNT and furnace minecarts directly with 5 ingots and the respective item.

Please make sure to download the datapack compatible with your minecraft version! Currently I support versions from 1.21.0 to 26.1. Future minecraft versions *may* continue working with the current datapack for 26.1, but if not I'll probably update it :)

![Example: Crafting a Hopper Minecart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0469d7c492c0b262811e476faa9760d36c09b93_0.webp)
